title: Private Network First-Time Setup flows — CLI + UI combined quickstart and troubleshooting visuals
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Design and deliver a coherent set of onboarding visuals and screenshots for Private/VPC first-time setup. Deliverables cover a hybrid experience that combines the Console-based quickstart with a lightweight CLI installer flow. Visuals must include a network topology diagram that shows tunnel/peering options, step-by-step install UI screens, an upgrade drift modal, and a troubleshooting checklist with example error states and resolution copy. The goal is to reduce first-run drop-off, shorten time-to-first-successful-connection, and provide assets for docs and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with complete flows: onboarding (Console + CLI), network topology, upgrade modal, and troubleshooting screens
Exported assets: SVG/PNG illustrations, component screenshots (desktop and tablet widths), and animated GIFs for handshake/tunnel sequence
Handoff-ready spec sheet with spacing, tokens, copy, and component variants for engineering
Sample screenshots with redacted tokens and seeded sample org data for marketing & docs
PM sign-off on copy and flow, and engineering confirmation of feasibility for modal behavior
Confluence quickstart page updated with new assets and a 2-minute walkthrough recording

design_notes: Use safe-color palette for secure/connected states: emerald-600 for success, slate-600 for neutral, amber-600 for warning, red-600 for errors
Topology diagram should use dashed lines for recommended paths and solid lines for enforced tunnels
Handshake animation limited to 3 loops and exported as GIF and Lottie (small file size target < 150KB)
Upgrade modal patterns: primary CTA = 'Apply upgrade', secondary = 'Schedule', tertiary = 'Rollback'
CLI output examples must be redacted; show token placeholders like <REDACTED_TOKEN> and avoid real IPs
Provide short alt text for each exported asset; attach to Confluence page for accessibility compliance
